required_opening: Baseball matters because the stakes are incredibly high.
required_frame: The July 20 board is not simply a list of standings. It is a pressure map.

dallas_detroit.hook: Dallas has only two games of separation to protect.

chicago_dallas.hook: Chicago cannot take the lead in this series, but it can erase the gap.
chicago_dallas.proof: Chicago is four games behind Dallas with four head-to-head games scheduled.
chicago_dallas.low_end: Dallas sweep pushes Chicago eight games back.

broader_races.hook: The pressure is not isolated to one division.

statsplus_rule.doctrine: StatsPlus enhances. It does not replace.

voice_checks: Begin with consequence rather than arithmetic.
Use records as proof rather than the hook.
Earn every dramatic word with measurable stakes.
Let the next game prove the story.
caution_flags: Chicago cannot take sole first place in this series.
No fake motivation or clubhouse invention.
No unsupported collapse, turnaround, luck, regression, injury-causation, fan-emotion, or blame language.
